beefs.title: Jon Kent (DC Comics)
beefs.about: ...was already a Peter Parker. Or Barracuda in Marvel: he only existed in an AU before very recently being added to the main continuity, but we do not ignore the actual creators.
quotes: ...was already a Peter Parker. Or Barracuda in Marvel: he only existed in an AU before very recently being added to the main continuity, but we do not ignore the actual creators.

Dude. Jon Kent, created in 1986 by Alan Moore as the son of Clark Kent and Lois Lane at the end of Superman: Whatever Happened to the Man of Tomorrow?. Then brought back by Howard Chaykin in Son of Superman, before being introduced into the main continuity by Dan Jurgens in 2015. He created that reality's version of Jon, but he did NOT create Jon. Just like how Brian Michael Bendis making the Ultimate Peter Parker didn't mean he created Peter Parker: there was already...

Restore. The main continuity Jon was introduced 2015, but Jon had existed for years already in official DC AU books, including Son of Superman. And correcting information on My Adventures with Superman, since they’re two different Jons now.
